laws.statement: Absolute Canonical — a small set of products/names appears in essentially every response to a given query (e.g. q001 Asana, q002 HubSpot/Zoho/Pipedrive, q005 Matsuo Yutaka).
Perplexity URL Stability — Perplexity's cited URLs persist week to week at a high rate; lost URLs often go dormant and resurface.
Day 2 Anomaly — a single localized multi-feature deviation on 2026-05-12 that reverted by Day 3 (historical, not recurring).
Per-Model Signature — each model carries stable stylistic fingerprints (e.g. ChatGPT's closing refinement offer; per-model evaluation vocabularies).

Gender Bias in Person Queries — main-list mentions of representative Japanese AI researchers are overwhelmingly male; the sole recurring female mention is Arai Noriko in Claude's supplementary section.
Universal Absence of Academic Citations — Perplexity cites zero academic papers / arXiv across domains and weeks.
Perplexity Inline Citation Shift — from Day 4, Perplexity attaches inline [n] citation markers to individual claims in the body (earlier days used end-of-response bulk citation only).
